It just so happens to be the home of the most beautiful girl in school! Perfect, pretty, and popular, Momogusa-san is amazing at everything she does and now Hataki will have a chance to see her in her element. But, he quickly learns something shocking: Momogusa is incredibly lazy at home! The moment she’s home from school, she seems to transform into a totally different version of herself and even expects to be pampered! Somehow she grows fond of Hataki and even begins to let him pamper her. Could this be the start of some sort of relationship or is Hataki just a glorified manservant? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Princess Liliana is betrothed to the kingdom's crown prince as a hostage in order to secure peace between the kingdom and the principality. One day, at a ball, the prince, having found a new lover, unilaterally breaks off the engagement and falsely accuses her of operating a gambling den for profit and embezzlement. Exiled and sent to the frontier, Liliana is attacked and killed along the way... only to find herself transported back to the day before the ball! Liliana works hard to gather evidence to avoid being falsely accused, and with the help of a mysterious man named Zeke, she successfully infiltrates the gambling den. However, her life is targeted there as well, and both of them lose their lives. Who is the culprit relentlessly pursuing Liliana's life...? To put an end to the cycle of death, Liliana and Zeke's battle begins now! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

He always comes out on top no matter what he does, and Hikari is determined to do whatever it takes to beat this guy...somehow! At age 6 Hikari lost to Kei in an impromptu wrestling match. Now, at 15, Hikari joins "Special A," a group of the top seven students at a private academy, for the opportunity to trounce the guy who made her suffer her first defeat. (Source: VIZ Media) Included one-shots: Volume 1: Mikansei Chorus Volume 11: Shoku no Miyako (Food Paradise) Included specials: - Vol.8 Special Short; The Hana to Yume 2006-09 The short is about what Kei was like as a child, and when he and Hikari first met. - Vol.9 Special Short; The Hana to Yume 2007-01 The short is about when Yuhiro meets Sakura. - Vol.16 Special Chapter; The Hana to Yume 2008-05 The chapter is about Hikari and Kei's middle school days.
